subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers require real Control UI browser/gateway proof for this watchdog branch before it is ported and merged, or explicitly waive that proof gate?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not just code shape: this timer-driven recovery changes session state and queued-message delivery, and the PR discussion already marks real behavior proof as missing.

options.title: Require proof before merge
options.body: Port and refresh the branch, then require a redacted browser/gateway artifact showing missed-terminal recovery, history reload, and queued follow-up flush before landing.

options.title: Override proof requirement
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly waive the proof gate if they accept landing the timer-driven recovery based on source review and tests alone.

options.title: Pause this replacement
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause or close this replacement if the proof and current-main port are not worth pursuing.

recommendation.title: Require proof before merge
recommendation.body: Port and refresh the branch, then require a redacted browser/gateway artifact showing missed-terminal recovery, history reload, and queued follow-up flush before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main chat module blame and adjacent `agent.wait` work make this the best available routing candidate for the proof/port decision.
